convertibility_reason: Uses ONNX neural network model for signal generation (non-standard external dependency), pending limit orders with Fibonacci-based entry, and multi-step AI-driven logic that requires careful conversion of the ONNX inference pipeline to Python equivalent.

derived_values.name: Feature 1: Distance from 50-bar high normalized by ATR
Feature 2: Distance from 50-bar low normalized by ATR
Feature 3: Volume ratio (current tick_volume / 20-bar avg volume)
Feature 4: Candle body normalized by ATR
Pivot High: highest bar in +/- 5 bar window
derived_values.formula: iHigh where bar is highest among i-5 to i+5

derived_values.name: Pivot Low: lowest bar in +/- 5 bar window
derived_values.formula: iLow where bar is lowest among i-5 to i+5

derived_values.name: Fibonacci entry level
derived_values.formula: p_high - (p_high - p_low) * FibLevel for buy; p_low + (p_high - p_low) * FibLevel for sell

params.note: 15 points below pivot low for buy, 15 points above pivot high for sell; actual pip distance varies with pivot distance
TP = entry + (entry - SL) * RR_ratio; effective pips = SL_distance * InpRR (default 2.0)
Trailing activates when profit distance >= full_RR_dist * InpTrailingStepRR; then moves SL to open +/- 30% of current_profit_dist

other_exits: Pending orders expire after InpExpireHours (default 4 hours) via ORDER_TIME_SPECIFIED
Fibonacci drawing deleted when no positions and no pending orders remain

custom_logic_notes: Neural network (ONNX) classifier with 4 output labels drives direction: labels 2-3 = bullish bias, labels 0-1 = bearish bias. Confidence must exceed threshold (0.65). Entry uses Fibonacci retracement of pivot high-low range at 61.8% level as pending limit order price. MA 50 acts as trend filter. Trailing stop is RR-based: activates at 0.8x of full RR distance, then locks 30% of unrealized profit. Pivot detection uses 5-bar window on each side (bars i-5 to i+5). Pending orders have time-based expiration (4 hours default).
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate ONNX inference pipeline using onnxruntime or equivalent Python ML framework. The 6-feature engineering (momentum, distance from extremes, volume ratio, candle body, hour) must be exactly matched. Pivot detection algorithm (5-bar window, scanning bars 5-100) must be ported precisely. Fibonacci-based pending order placement requires careful price-level calculation matching MT5 NormalizeDouble behavior. Trailing stop is RR-based (not pip-based) which requires tracking original SL distance. The confidence threshold and label-to-signal mapping (0-1=bearish, 2-3=bullish) must be preserved. Pending order expiration handling needs broker-specific consideration.
